title: C.J. Barrymore's
specs: More than 20 indoor and outdoor attractions including 2 coasters and 3 go-kart tracks
Recommended for ages 6 and up; most attractions require minimum height of 40 inches
Guests must have state issued photo ID or passport to enter the park
Adult accompaniment required on some rides; one child per adult
Pregnant women may ride the Ferris Wheel only
Long hair and hijabs must be securely tied above shoulders on all rides
No group discounts but group packages available
Field trips minimum 50 guests, $34 per person, weekdays May-August, includes lunch and 4-hour unlimited wristband excluding arcade and golf dome
Private party rooms and holiday event packages available with food menus and minimum spends
Holiday party packages available in December with private rooms and menus, $46.99 per person plus tax and gratuity

blurb: C.J. Barrymore's offers more than 20 indoor and outdoor attractions including 2 coasters, 3 go-kart tracks, and over 100 arcade games. The park is family-friendly and enforces a dress code and behavior policy. Attractions have height and age requirements, generally recommended for ages 6 and up and 40" height minimum.
